breakdown.description: Inviscid simulation requested but top wall uses noSlip; inviscid wall should not impose no-slip viscous condition
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly requested a `noSlip` boundary condition for the top wall in an inviscid simulation. The ground truth correctly changes this to a `slip` boundary condition. The agent's generated specification repeated the original error, stating: 'Apply noSlip velocity boundary condition on the top wall.'
